ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of high-intensity white/light-gray pixels to low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central region; solid black perimeter along the trailing edge and tips; vertical black linear mottling on the left lobe; dense black stippling and irregular patches on the medial and trailing regions of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; upper angle estimated at 50 degrees; lower vertex obscured by water spray and splashing.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the left trailing edge; right trailing edge exhibits a significant large-scale non-linear excision (notch) approximately one-third of the way from the median notch to the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the leading edge leading to acute, tapered tips; concave curvature on the trailing edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly visible clusters of circular, high-contrast white and beige calcified nodes (barnacles) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct vertical black linear streaks (rake marks) observed on the lower-left quadrant of the left lobe's ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large irregular indentation/traumatic loss of tissue on the trailing edge of the right lobe; extensive barnacle colonization and associated scarring on both fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant water turbulence and spray occluding the lower peduncle attachment and the base of the median notch.
